summary: When an attack angers a peaceful priest in a temple, mon.c:wakeup calls priest.c:ghod_hitsu before the later uhitm.c:hmon wrapper. The C function selects a temple boundary with rn2(4), tests whether the hero is lined up with that square, and returns early when the line fails; JavaScript currently skips the function at both active callers. The v43 case reaches this boundary choice and exposes the missing draw while all 80 screens and cursors match. Port ghod_hitsu, wire both callers, and provide the source-exact a_gname_at and a_gname helpers for its deity messages and their other active callers.

source.branch: In an occupied temple with a priest who has a shrine, ghod_hitsu checks the altar position and line to the hero. When the hero is already on the shrine or is not lined up with it, it uses the door geometry or rn2(4) to choose a temple boundary, then returns if linedup() fails. A valid line consumes rn2(3), prints one of three deity responses, fires a six-die monster lightning spell from the selected square, restores current_wand and buzzer, and exercises Wisdom.
functions: wakeup() whole mon.c:4333-4362; preserve the existing hot_pursuit frontier
hmon() whole uhitm.c:817-834; preserve the existing angry_guards caller
a_gname_at() whole pray.c:2514-2520; pure altar-to-deity name helper required by ghod_hitsu's consumed message value
a_gname() whole pray.c:2507-2509; pure current-square wrapper wired into active offer_different_alignment_altar(), offer_corpse(), and invent.c:dfeature_at() callers
callers: mon.c:wakeup:4357-4358 calls ghod_hitsu after setmangry when via_attack and the priest was peaceful; this is the exercised C path in the selected session
uhitm.c:hmon:829-830 calls ghod_hitsu after hmon_hitmon when the priest gate rn2(2) succeeds
pray.c:offer_different_alignment_altar:1642,1651,1660 and pray.c:offer_corpse:1981 call a_gname(); the active JS equivalents now use a_gname(state)
invent.c:dfeature_at:4078 calls a_gname(); js/look_here calls dfeature_at(ux,uy), and its altar branch now uses the exact hero-square wrapper
pray.c:offer_real_amulet:1542,1567,1569 also call a_gname(), but js/pray.js:413 explicitly refuses that source path, so there is no active JS production caller to wire
dependencies: Reuse existing priest.c:temple_occupied and has_shrine implementations in js/priest.js.
Reuse mthrowu.c:linedup in js/mthrowu.js; boulderhandling 1 skips its random test but retains its gt.tbx/gt.tby updates for the following direction.
Reuse zap.c:buzz and dobuzz plus the existing lightning zhitu path in js/zap.js; the ghod_hitsu caller discards buzz's return value, but the ray's side effects are required.
Reuse attrib.c:exercise, hacklib.c:sgn, const.js:IS_DOOR and u_at, and hacklib.c:s_suffix.

The existing pray.c:a_align macro and align_gname implementation in js/pray.js supply the pure alignment operations for a_gname_at and a_gname. Active pray.js callers and invent.js:dfeature_at use the source wrapper; offer_real_amulet remains fail-closed and has no active JS caller.
